# Genesis Hacks

> Genesis connects companies with India's student hackathon and builder community. We curate brand partnerships with independent hackathons and run our own series, Hackers Occupied.

## Facts
- 140+ events run or partnered on across India, 21,699 attendees in total (35% women).
- Own series: Hackers Occupied. Hackers Occupied Pune took place on 22–23 August 2026 at Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT), Pune.
- Next: Hackers Occupied Delhi 2027, Delhi NCR, Mid-January 2027 (tentative). 100 teams of 3 to 5. Tracks: AI, Web3, FinTech, Agro, Healthcare, CyberSecurity. Dates and venue are tentative.
- Event Partner at: Hackaccino 4.0 (Bennett University, Greater Noida); Innovate 4.0 (IIT Delhi); CodeClash 2.0 (Google Office, Gurugram); 0xGenIgnite (NIT Goa).

## Contact
- Sponsors and partners: partner@genesishacks.com, +91 70433 88006
- Reply time: within 2 business days
